Subject: New pilot - DPA request and timeline

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Retailly is excited to move into a short pilot with Redwood. Our legal team has asked for a standard DPA before we exchange any PII in the pilot. Attached is our intake (Retailly_DPA_Request.pdf) outlining the data flows and required clauses (SCCs, subprocessors, retention).

Can your team share your DPA redline and confirm who will be signing on Redwood's side? We are aiming to start data ingest the week of May 6th, so a quick turnaround would help.

Thanks,

Retailly Inc.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-12T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood DPA redline (Retailly) - key open items

Priya / Jordan —

I looked through Retailly’s intake and our redline highlights three items that will need confirmation from their side before we can finalize:

1) SCCs: Retailly asks for EU SCCs to be baseline for international transfers. We can accept SCCs but need to confirm the execution flow (attach SCC addendum) and who is the exporter/importer for the pilot.

2) Retention: their intake lists 7 years for "analytics retention" which is longer than our standard 13 months. Recommend we offer a carveout for the pilot (13 months) and propose a documented exception for longer retention with product team sign-off.

3) Subprocessors: they ask for a 10-day notice window for onboarding new subprocessors. We typically provide a 30-day notice with opt-out rights for certain regulated customers. Ask Retailly if 30 days will be a blocker.

I’ve added inline comments in Redwood_DPA_redline_v1.docx and created a condensed PDF with our position (Redwood_DPA_final_redline.pdf). Jordan — can you draft the signer matrix once Samir confirms their signer authority?

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_final_redline.pdf (pdf)

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@nimbusretail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: legal@retailly.com
Date: 2028-04-13T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA redline (Retailly) - key open items

Marissa — thanks for the thorough pass. Responses inline below and attaching our Privacy_Schedule as requested.

1) SCCs: We are fine with the SCCs as baseline — Retailly will act as exporter for EU-sourced test data. We can sign the SCC addendum.

2) Retention: The 7-year ask was for a subset of historical analytics (archival). For the pilot we can accept 13 months; long-term retention is a commercial ask we can raise in renewal conversations.

3) Subprocessors: 30 days is acceptable for Retailly, provided we get notice to a single inbox (legal@retailly.com).

We attach Retailly_Privacy_Schedule.pdf with the specific dataset names. Also: Retailly prefers a single signature on our side from our GC (Allyson Greene). We can execute via DocuSign if you send the envelope.

Thanks,
Samir

Attachment: Retailly_Privacy_Schedule.pdf (pdf)

Priya
